tokens.description: Set only on action:'agent_run_usage' rows (governance.ts's recordAgentRunUsage) — an interactive agent run's own prompt+completion token delta, the completion-time counterpart to agent-thread's own 'usage' JSON field (which only ever holds the LATEST run's numbers, not a history). Lets enforceAgentTokenBudget sum a workspace's real monthly AI usage across chat runs, not just background jobs.
